messages:
Miranda: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — summarizing the action items and owners so nothing slips. Please ack and paste the Jira link when you create the ticket.

Ashok: ACK. I'll take the perf investigation ticket.

Miranda: Ashok, noted. Can you create a Jira with acceptance criteria (repro steps, perf target, test plan)? Prefer `ENG-` prefix.

Ashok: Yep — creating `ENG-4827` now. Summary: "Investigate KV cache thrashing under bursty tails; propose config or code change to reduce evictions". ETA Weds EOD.

Devon: I'll own the rollout plan and can do a canary on dedicated for 24h. Will create the rollout ticket `RELEASE-231`. cc @Sylvia for QA.

Sylvia: I can take QA validation and add test cases to our perf harness. Need the exact workload script from Ashok to simulate.

Miranda: RACI mapping in one line so it's clear: R=Ashok (investigation), A=Miranda (postmortem lead), C=Sylvia (QA) & Devon (rollout), I=Laura (product) + SRE oncall.

Laura: I (product) will review impact and prioritization. Please @me on the ENG ticket when it's created.

Miranda: Action list (copy/paste from thread):
- ENG-4827 (Ashok) — root cause analysis + concrete remediation options. Due: Wed EOD. R: Ashok, C: Sylvia.
- RELEASE-231 (Devon) — rollout plan + canary checklist. Due: Thu EOD. R: Devon, A: Miranda.
- QA-Perf (Sylvia) — validation scripts & regression tests. Due: Thu EOD. R: Sylvia.
- DOCS-89 (Laura/eng-docs) — runbook update & incident playbook additions. Due: Fri.
- OBS-190 (ops-bot) — create an alert refinement ticket to reduce noisey paging during KV transient. R: ops-bot (SRE). Due: Mon.

Ashok: Created ENG-4827: https://jira.redwood/ENG-4827 — added repro snippets and initial hypothesis. Assigning to me.

Devon: RELEASE-231 is created: https://jira.redwood/RELEASE-231. Canary checklist attached. Scheduling canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

Sylvia: QA-Perf created as `QA-77`: https://jira.redwood/QA-77. I added a workload script note — Ashok, can you drop the `wrk` command sample in ENG-4827 so I can copy?

Ashok: Pasted sample: `wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s --timeout 5s http://private-infer:8080/generate` — this reproduces high prefix hits.

Miranda: Good. A couple of governance notes:
- Handoff: when ENG-4827 has a clear remediation candidate, Ashok -> Devon handoff meeting to schedule rollout.
- Acceptance criteria must include no regressions on p50/p95 and a 30% reduction in cache eviction rate on synthetic test.
- If the remediation requires model or quantization changes, loop in Research/ML before rollout.

Devon: I'll put the Ashok->Devon handoff meeting on the calendar once ENG-4827 has a proposed diff.

Laura: Also flagging that this pattern (KV cache eviction under bursty tails) has recurred 3x in the last 6 months per our incident index. Can we add an action to consolidate prior postmortems into a single recurring-pattern issue?

Miranda: Yes — adding `ENG-4901` to consolidate historical incidents and detect recurrence triggers. R: Miranda, A: Laura, C: Ashok, I: SRE. Due: 2 weeks.

Sylvia: Quick Q: who owns communicating ETA to customers if the fix needs a rolling restart? Ops or product?

Laura: Product owns customer comms but will coordinate with Ops for timeline and messaging. I can draft a short note once we have dates.

Ashok: One more: please add a field in Jira for "postmortem pattern" so we can tag incidents for recurrence tracking. I'll add that to ENG-4827.

Miranda: Thanks everyone. Can folks react with :white_check_mark: once your ticket is created and you accept ownership? I'll close the loop on Thurs with a quick sync.

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation starts in 2 hours — @oncall will be paged for any firing alerts.

Devon: ✅ RELEASE-231 created and I'm owner.

Ashok: ✅ ENG-4827 created and I'll drive it.

Sylvia: ✅ QA-77 created. Will start runs when Ashok's script is in.

Laura: ✅ DOCS-89 created and I'll coordinate comms.

Miranda: Closing note: Emily from Research recommended a short design review if the fix touches KV caching internals. If ENG-4827 points that way, cc Emily and schedule 30m.

Miranda: (last) I'll update the postmortem doc with all ticket links and mark owners in the KVP. Thanks.
